rules.reason: The item's DetailFrame body scrolls (1018 px in the 766 px window): Figma's item runs on under the tab bar, and the render's page runs under the pinned tab bar (AppShell tabBarOverlay) the same way (deviations.md "Under the tab bar.").
The item tabs scroll sideways on the phone (438 px of tabs in 366): Activity runs past the screen's right edge in Figma's tab row too (deviations.md "Item tabs.").

The preview bar is one line, as in Figma: the lock and Read-only run past the box's right edge, where the box cuts them (Figma's Read-only, 487:1660, starts at x 390, past the 378 px box) (deviations.md "Preview bar."; LIBRARY_GAPS.md "File preview").
